title: Fraud in the Polish elections declared by Lukashenko
text: EUvsDisinfo – przypadek dezinformacji: Fraud in the Polish elections declared by Lukashenko. SUMMARY The Polish president Andrzej Duda, who won a second mandate in July 2020, has won the presidential election after falsifying the results. Moreover, Polish authorities have tried to organise protests in Belarus but instead were affected by a similar development (meaning the wide protests against making abortions illegal). RESPONSE
